clips.title: The story
paras: Ironforge's Great Forge burns beneath the mountain, at the heart of dwarven rule and Alliance trade. Deep inside Ironforge Mountain in Dun Morogh, the city is the political and mercantile anchor of Khaz Modan and a bulwark of the Alliance.

Ironforge fills the deep halls of Ironforge Mountain, its stone rings circling the Great Forge. The dwarves founded the city millennia ago, after awakening and migrating from Uldaman. It has weathered ages of history, including the ancient War of the Three Hammers, which left the Bronzebeard clan in sole control. Natural magma pours through the mountain to power the city, while massive stone gates guard its halls. Dwarven craftsmen and warriors share them with many exiled gnomes, who came after the recent fall of Gnomeregan.

Ironforge is perhaps the Alliance's busiest center of commerce and industry. King Magni Bronzebeard rules Khaz Modan from the High Seat, while dwarven prospectors, miners, and engineers work alongside gnome refugees in Tinker Town. The Deeprun Tram runs beneath the mountains to Stormwind City, carrying trade and troops at high speed and keeping the capitals linked in mutual defense.
